content: media_kit_video (main c533e44, 2026-08-30): Windows = ANGLE GLES into a private D3D11 texture, glFinish per frame, CopyResource into a 2nd shared texture inside the compositor descriptor callback, all players serialized on ThreadPool(1); resize/video-size change unregisters + re-registers a new texture id; SW path capped at 1080p. Linux = isolated EGL ctx + EGLImage, mpv renders inside FlTextureGL populate on raster thread, single buffer + glFlush (tearing #1345, black on Mesa Xe2 #1463, broken by Flutter 3.38 own EGL ctx #1321/PR1325). macOS = CGL OpenGL + 3 IOSurface CVPixelBuffers, main.sync per frame, freezes during window resize #1176. hwdec default 'auto' set by VideoController.create; no zero-copy on Windows (#296, #1278; waits for mpv PR17764).
